question: What will be the percentage change in Amazon (AMZN) stock (AMZN on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-09-03 to the close on 2026-10-02?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-10-02 / close on 2026-09-03 - 1), using daily closes of AMZN on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-10-02, the last close before it is used.

research:
AMZN closed at $258.90 on 2026-09-03, which is the base for the question. Nothing so far settles the outcome. The stock had fallen about 9% from its August 3 record close, partly because the FTC and 22 states sued over its ad auctions on August 31. Between now and October 2 there is no earnings report or other scheduled Amazon catalyst, so macro data and the Fed meeting matter more.

## 1. Resolution source
- The result uses AMZN daily closes on Yahoo Finance, from 2026-09-03 to 2026-10-02. The tools couldn't reach Yahoo directly. The code-collected Yahoo data gives a 2026-09-03 close of $258.90.
- 2026-09-03: StockAnalysis matches. It shows a close of $258.90, up 1.54% on the day, with an open of $256.20, a range of $256.00 to $259.50 and volume of about 26.9M. [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/amzn/history/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened that settles or nearly settles the question. The window has only just opened.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-03: Markets rallied broadly as bond yields fell. One recap has the Nasdaq Composite up 1.40% and the S&P 500 up 1.06% to 7,747.71. That recap gets the weekday wrong, so treat its numbers with caution. QQQ closed at 717.67, up from 709.24. [tapeboard](https://tapeboard.com/blog/market-pulse-2026-09-03), [financialcontent](https://www.financialcontent.com/quote/NQ%3AQQQ/historical)
- 2026-09-02: AMZN closed at about $254.98, down roughly 2%, which put it below its 100-day moving average. Citi's Ronald Josey said the firm would "take advantage of any dislocation," pointing to AWS demand. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/article/amazon-stock-just-entered-the-danger-zone-104050035.html)
- 2026-08-31: The FTC and 22 states sued Amazon in federal court in Washington state.
  - They allege Amazon has manipulated its ad auctions since 2018, overcharging about 1.2M advertisers by more than $20B.
  - They want the practices stopped, civil penalties and refunds.
  - Amazon calls the suit "misguided" and says it relies on "cherry-picked" documents.
  - Shares fell as much as 4.6% after the filing and closed at $259.77, down 2.5%.
  - [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/08/31/ftc-amazon-deceptive-advertising-lawsuit), [Outlook Business](https://www.outlookbusiness.com/corporate/ftc-22-us-states-sue-amazon-over-alleged-20-bn-ad-auction-manipulation), [capital.com](https://capital.com/en-int/analysis/amazon-stock-forecast-is-it-a-buy)
- 2026-08-31: AMZN finished August at $259.77, down 6.7% for the month. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/amzn-stock-price-in-august-2026)
- 2026-08-28: Shares jumped 3.97% to $266.43. [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/amzn/history/)
- 2026-08-27: Shares fell to $256.88, the lowest level since July. [Trading Economics](https://tradingeconomics.com/amzn:us/news/578732)
- 2026-08-24: A Motley Fool piece noted that AMZN was lagging the S&P 500 in 2026. [Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/24/amazon-is-lagging-the-sp-500-in-2026-this-is-the-o/)
- 2026-08-03: AMZN hit a record close of $284.02 and passed $3T in market value after Q2 results. [aiweekly](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/amazon-becomes-fifth-3-trillion-company-on-aws-ai-surge)
  - AWS grew 37% year over year, its fastest in 18 quarters, with a $496B backlog.
  - Amazon raised 2026 capex guidance to about $220B.
  - One source reports quarterly free cash flow of about -$7.6B. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/amazon-reports-q2-2026-earnings-raises-full-year-capital-expenditure-to-220-billion)

- That puts the interquartile range at about 10 points and the 90% range at about 29 points. The median has a mild upward drift.
- Recent volatility is high: single-day moves were +3.97% on Aug 28 and -2.5% on Aug 31, and the stock fell 6.7% in August.
- The stock is about 9% below its Aug 3 record close.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on AMZN's price for this window.
- Analyst consensus is Buy or Strong Buy, with 12-month targets averaging about $321 to $327:
  - MarketBeat (dated Sep 4): $323.26 from 59 analysts. [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/AMZN/forecast/)
  - Bullstory (Aug 22): $326.84, with a range of $230 to $405. [Bullstory](https://bullstory.io/en/stocks/amzn/forecast)
  - Walnut: 59 buy, 3 hold, 0 sell ratings. [Walnut](https://walnutinvest.com/stocks/amzn/forecast)
- 2026-07-31: UBS raised its target to $318 and Telsey to $335.

## 6. Upcoming events before Oct 2
- 2026-09-04: US August jobs report (normally the first Friday of the month; I did not confirm this year's date).
- 2026-09-07: Labor Day, market closed.
- Mid-September: the August CPI release and an FOMC meeting. I did not confirm the exact dates; the FOMC usually meets in mid-September.
- The FTC ad-auction case may see early filings, more states joining, or analysts estimating the hit to the ad business. Nothing is scheduled that I could find.
- Prime Big Deal Days usually falls in early October (Oct 7-8 in 2025), so the 2026 event probably comes after Oct 2. A date announcement could land inside the window.
- Q3 earnings are expected in late October, after the window closes. No Amazon earnings fall inside it.
- AI and capex sentiment across megacap tech, including any AWS or Anthropic headlines, and bond-yield swings could move the stock.
